requirements.name: Satellite or airborne platform experience
requirements.note: Text describes ground-segment processing of data downlinked from a satellite mission, not design or implementation of an instrument or system that itself flew on a satellite or aircraft platform; the candidate explicitly states 'I've never designed an instrument or worked on the processing that runs onboard' (cover_letter). Kept conservative rather than inferring satellite-platform experience from the employer's name or mission context.

lines.quote: Hold a Finnish residence permit (type A, specialist work), obtained through employer sponsorship in 2020, valid for EU work in Finland.
All documentation written in English, which is the company working language
Relocating for this role would be straightforward and genuinely welcome.

ask_in_screening.question: Can you describe any hands-on experience you have with phased-array or beamforming signal-processing algorithms, if any?
Can you describe your experience writing embedded signal-processing software in C or C++ that has run on production hardware under real-time constraints, if any?
Can you describe your experience writing Python to production or engineering standards, if any?
